para_before: The analysis took the Japanese public healthcare payer perspective and a lifetime horizon, to capture differences in survival. Costs and QALYs were discounted at 2% per year, as the Japanese guideline specifies [40]. The willingness-to-pay threshold for exercise was 5 million Japanese yen (JPY) per QALY [41,42]; the higher threshold of JPY 7.5 million per QALY applies only to designated products given special consideration, such as anticancer drugs [42], and pembrolizumab was assessed at both.
